title: Ilustración Dinámica de Chica Anime con Ángulo Holandés Cinematográfico e Iluminación Teatral
prompt: Create a vertical anime-style illustration with theatrical animation quality artwork, featuring a beautiful anime girl character with a dynamic composition. The image uses a deliberate Dutch angle with the entire frame tilted diagonally, completely eliminating vertical and horizontal lines. The camera captures her upper body from a slightly low angle in close-up, showing her in a graceful, twisted pose that conveys both dynamism and natural movement from the waist up. The lighting is cinematic and dramatic, evoking the highest quality production values of a late-night anime theatrical film.
